class.name: HeightmapTerrain3D
class.brief_description: Renders and edits a simple heightmap-based landscape.
class.description: Generates a triangle mesh from a [TerrainHeightmap], including normals, UVs, and vertex colors. The editor provides brush tools for raising, lowering, vertex-color painting, and painting four texture layers, with Undo/Redo. Assign textures to the layer properties to enable the built-in splat-blend shader; an explicit custom [member terrain_material] takes precedence. The generated mesh is regenerated when height or color data changes. [b]Note:[/b] The current implementation is intended for small meshes only, as editing any sample rebuilds the entire mesh. Physics collision, tiled LOD, foliage, and world streaming are not generated automatically.

method.name: build_mesh
method.description: Generates an independent mesh from the current heightmap.

method.name: sample_height_local
method.description: Samples the height at local 3D coordinates, accounting for [member cell_size].
